title: A complexity phase transition at the EPR Hamiltonian
summary: We study the computational complexity of 2-local Hamiltonian problems generated by a positive-weight symmetric interaction term, encompassing many canonical problems in statistical mechanics and optimization. We show these problems belong to one of three complexity phases: QMA-complete, StoqMA-complete, and reducible to a new problem we call EPR*. The phases are physically interpretable, corresponding to the energy level ordering of the local term. The EPR* problem is a simple generalization of the EPR problem of King.
